Get to alignment on our go-forward posture on the Oyelaran contract before the Q3 OTB lock.

Agenda
1. Level-set (5 min). Current state of the Oyelaran SKU rationalization, landed cost deltas vs. plan, and where the vendor scorecard is trending. Kenji to share the deck.
2. Options framing (10 min). Renew as-is, renegotiate MOQs and payment terms, or begin a phased exit with dual-sourcing. Leon to speak to DC capacity and inbound flow impacts.
3. Decision / RACI (10 min). We need a recommendation we can socialize upward. Thandi holds the pen on the risk register implications.
4. Next steps & owners (5 min)
